headline.purpose: Names the confirmed operating context or major administrative destination.

body.purpose: Primary reading and form content in compact task-oriented screens.

label.purpose: Explicit names for controls, table columns, roles, and metadata.

shadows.name: sidebar
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for the contiguous authenticated shell.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Global effective duration under prefers-reduced-motion; transforms are removed from moving agenda surfaces.

components.name: Support-State Boundary
components.description: Persistent structural signature for reason-bound, time-limited, read-only CRV support.
components.css: .ds-support-boundary { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b91c1c 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, #b91c1c 10%, transparent); color: #080d19; } .ds-support-boundary strong, .ds-support-boundary small { display: block; } .ds-support-boundary button { margin-inline-start: auto; }

narrative.overview: A calm navy-and-gold operating environment where every action visibly belongs to one server-confirmed tenant, platform, or temporary support context. Brand emphasis is scarce; hierarchy, containment, and factual state carry trust.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained navy surfaces with purposeful gold emphasis
Continuously visible organization and authority context
Structural separation for platform and support work
Intentional light, dark, reduced-motion, and 320px behavior

rules.name: Gold Is Scarce
rules.body: Use gold for focus, selection, brand, and primary action—not as a large decorative wash.

rules.name: State Has More Than Color
rules.body: Every authority and support state needs direct language and semantic structure in addition to color.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Operational hierarchy comes from tonal layers and one-pixel boundaries; elevation is reserved for overlays, shell separation, and bounded brand surfaces.

dos: Use server-confirmed context and authorization facts.
Keep Brazilian Portuguese copy direct and factual.
Preserve keyboard, focus, screen-reader, 320px, dark-theme, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not merge tenant, platform, and support into one generic dashboard.
Do not communicate authority or status by color alone.
Do not imply impersonation, payment collection, or unsupported authority.
